scheme_name: Andaman & Nicobar Bed & Breakfast / Home Stay Establishment Scheme
other_conditions: Owner/promoter and immediate family must physically reside in the establishment
Must let out at least one room and at most six rooms (maximum 12 beds)
benefits_summary: Allows owners to obtain official classification for their Bed & Breakfast/Homestay, enabling them to operate legally and charge guests for up to three years.
